numeric_complexity_contract.reference: evaluate F at every grid point and keep the first minimum
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: binary search for the first grid index j with F(x_j) <= F(x_{j+1}) (convexity makes the grid sequence unimodal), O(lines) per evaluation
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(lines * log((b - a) / eps)) time, O(1) extra space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: event simulation of every insertion with explicit ready times
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: prefix sums of usage; in steady state battery i is idle for (total usage - usage[i]) minutes, so feasibility after the first pass is one check per battery; full passes are counted arithmetically and the last partial pass by binary search on the prefix sums
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n log n) time, O(n) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: literal reduction rounds through a queue of digits
